description: Change how the sign language interpreter (Libras) window shows on a video's player: start time, size, position, autostart, or a free position/size. Only fields passed are changed. The interpreter clip itself is uploaded and removed on the dashboard (Video → Settings → Libras); this tool does not create or delete it. Choosing a preset size or position drops the free position (custom), like the dashboard. Returns the updated sign language entry.

autostart.description: true = interpreter already on when the video starts

custom.description: Free position and size (fractions of the player, 0–1); overrides size/position

width.description: Window width, fraction of the player width

x.description: Left edge, fraction of the player width

y.description: Top edge, fraction of the player height

language.description: Sign language, by the country's language code ('pt-br' = Libras); needed only if the video has more than one

start_time.description: Second of the video when the window appears

video_id.description: Video ID (the main video, not the interpreter clip)

name: panda_update_sign_language_display
title: Update Sign Language Display
